name: Disgusting Stench Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min/level
Saving Throw Will partial; see text; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

As disgusting stench, but in addition to being regurgitated if swallowed whole, no animal or creature with an Intelligence score will bite you more than once if they fail a Will save. For the duration of this extract any creature with the scent ability gains a +10 circumstance bonus to locate or track you.
